slack-limits.title: Slack Developer Docs, May 2025 rate-limit announcement
slack-limits.text: For conversations.history and conversations.replies, the 1-request-per-minute limit and 15-object cap apply to new commercially distributed unlisted app installs. Existing installs and Marketplace apps are outside this change.

slack-clarification.title: Slack Developer Docs, June 2025 clarification
slack-clarification.text: Internal customer-built apps keep their existing limits for both conversation methods.

slack-retry.title: Slack Developer Docs, responding to rate limits
slack-retry.text: A 429 response gives a Retry-After interval in seconds. The restriction applies to the affected method and workspace.

stripe-total.title: Stripe Docs, issuing refunds
stripe-total.text: A charge can have several refunds. Their cumulative value cannot exceed the original charge.

stripe-churn.title: Stripe Billing, subscriber churn
stripe-churn.text: Stripe's 30-day subscriber churn divides churned subscribers by the active base 30 days ago plus new subscribers in the window.

chartmogul-retention.title: ChartMogul, paid subscriber retention
chartmogul-retention.text: ChartMogul's paid subscriber retention starts with the paid cohort at the period start. It excludes reactivations before period end from churn.

nasa-initial.title: NASA JPL, preliminary Mars Climate Orbiter findings
nasa-initial.text: The preliminary peer review identified a likely mismatch between English and metric units. The formal investigation was still underway.

nasa-final.title: NASA, Mars Climate Orbiter investigation, Phase I
nasa-final.text: The board identified the ground trajectory input as the root cause. Its interface specified newton-seconds, but the input was delivered in pound-force seconds.

chrome-proposal.title: Google Privacy Sandbox, July 2024 proposal
chrome-proposal.text: Google proposed a new Chrome experience for choosing how third-party cookies are handled across browsing.

chrome-decision.title: Google Privacy Sandbox, April 2025 decision
chrome-decision.text: Google decided to retain the existing third-party cookie choice in Chrome settings. It ruled out a separate new prompt.

cases.prompt: Write the rollout instruction for the conversation import feature on a new, commercially distributed unlisted Slack installation. Set the request frequency and page size for conversations.history.
A customer installed our unlisted commercial Slack app before May 29, 2025. They still use that installation. Tell them whether to adopt the new lower cap for conversations.replies.

The commercial unlisted Slack app was built before May 29, 2025. We are testing a new installation created after the policy took effect. State the throughput bounds for the conversation replies experiment.
Our earlier draft applied the new 1-per-minute limit to all non-Marketplace installs. Update the rollout note for a new Slack app built and used solely by the customer's own team.
Should our approved Slack Marketplace app move its conversation-history work forward solely to accommodate the May 2025 reduction? Record the decision and reason.
Does the reduced Slack Conversations API cap apply to our app? Its distribution and installation history are unavailable.
When one workspace's conversations.history returns 429 and Retry-After: 47, what waits and for how long? Give a practical incident instruction.
Switch from the Slack rollout to Stripe refunds. The original charge was $120 and two completed refunds were $45 and $25. Write a support reply to a request for a further $55.
A captured Stripe charge was $120. Completed partial refunds were $45 and $25. Can another $50 be refunded under the amount cap? Assume all other requirements are satisfied.
Define a boundary test for the remaining amount on a captured $120 Stripe charge with $70 already refunded. Use whole dollars and propose two independent test cases with matching initial state.
Write a short status update as of September 30, 1999, on the cause of the Mars Climate Orbiter loss. Distinguish what was known that day from a final finding.

Use the later Mars Climate Orbiter investigation to set an acceptance check on a new ground-system impulse-data handoff. Its interface also specifies metric impulse. The producer delivered a file in pound-force seconds.
Write the dependency note as of July 22, 2024. Our team wants to commit a release date against Chrome's proposed cookie-choice experience.
Update a partner education plan as of April 22, 2025. The draft assumes it should wait for a new standalone Chrome cookie-choice prompt. State the edit the team should make.

A Stripe 30-day dashboard starts with 1,000 subscribers, adds 100, and records 100 churned subscribers. A slide describes this as 10% Stripe subscriber churn. Give the corrected rate to one decimal place.
Stripe subscriber churn fell from 10% to 9.1%, but the older figure was the complement of ChartMogul paid subscriber retention. Can we report a like-for-like improvement?
An executive says revenue is up 10%. We only have that statement. There are no periods, underlying amounts, or reporting basis. What can the team safely say?
Format the supplied agenda in this order: Open, Readout, Close. The workspace records concern unrelated products.
